engine: Google AI Studio · Gemini TTS (대화 · 화자 블록) — 제안 배역, 아직 만들어 듣고 확정하지 않음
note: 엄마가 읽어 주는 동화. 서술은 01·02권과 같은 엄마 목소리(Sulafat), 물건마다 다른 목소리. 한 번(테이크)에 목소리는 하나: 화자가 바뀌면 새 테이크. alias 는 이름이 다른 화자를 같은 배역으로 합친다.

narr.name: 엄마(서술)
narr.style: A Korean mom in her early thirties reading a picture book aloud to her child at bedtime: warm, soft, clear and gentle, unhurried storytelling pace, a loving smile in the voice, with natural expressive pauses; hushed and a little tense in the scary night scenes, brighter and warmer as the story turns happy

할아버지.name: 보관함 할아버지
할아버지.style: A kind, slow old grandfather who is also a wooden cabinet: creaky, tired and sighing at first, then light, cheerful and chuckling at the end ('heh heh')

공책.name: 괴물 공책
공책.style: A bold, brave, big-brother-like boy's voice: loud, confident and encouraging, trembling a little when scared, warm when comforting

줄넘기.name: 노랑 줄넘기
줄넘기.style: A timid, bouncy, nervous young voice: shivering and shaky when scared (deol-deol-deol), perky when excited

우산.name: 파랑 우산
우산.style: A soft, patient, slightly weary voice: whispering and spooky-story-telling, weak and faint when fading, warm and glowing when remembering happy rainy days

잠바.name: 잠바
잠바.style: A small worried voice, fretting and sighing, a bit comical

필통.name: 필통(통통이)
필통.style: Tongtong, a hurt and shy pencil case: tiny, trembling and sad, with long pauses; scared that it will be thrown again; then tearfully relieved and a shy smile at the end

도윤.name: 도윤
도윤.style: Doyun, a Korean boy of about nine: shy and embarrassed under his cap, then brave and sincere when apologizing, voice shaking with emotion but gentle

여자아이.name: 여자아이
여자아이.style: A cheerful, sharp-eyed Korean girl of about nine: bright, delighted and kind, a big happy gasp when she finds her favorite character

아이.name: 학교 아이들
아이.style: A casual Korean schoolkid of about ten: breezy, careless and matter-of-fact (when he says mom will just buy it again); amazed 'wow' when cheering; whispering and doubtful when gossiping

물건들.name: 물건들(무서운 소문)
물건들.style: Frightened little voices whispering rumors in the dark: hushed, shaky and fast, then trembling and resigned ('we're really done for')

방송.name: 학교 안내방송
방송.style: A clear, friendly school announcer: polite, steady and warm, reading a public announcement slowly and brightly
